messages.subject: Cannot access account name
parts:
Hello,
I signed up to ShinyApps back in Alpha/Beta stage I think, and obtained the account name 'cainesap', under which I've deployed several applications (e.g. https://cainesap.shinyapps.io/boardgamegeek)
However, I cannot link this account name to my registered username (this email, 'cainesap' at 'gmail.com'), and would like to know how to 'retrieve' my account name please.
I don't recall whether I signed up with this email or via Google in the first place, but it was one of the two, and if I try to sign in with Google the same thing happens.
many thanks, Andrew

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Cannot access account name
parts:
I have responded to the email account you used to register for that account.  Please check your other email addresses for a note that has the needed information for you to login.

Best of luck,
Tareef
